title: 동료에게 고마움 전하기: 제 일까지 대신 해 준 줄 몰랐어요
summary: A coworker thanks a colleague who finished his work.
setting: An office break room on Monday morning. 민준 was in the hospital last week.

task.title: Practice saying thank you
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expression list to complete each task, then check your answers on the next page.

words.meaning: to make someone worry about you
words.exampleMeaning: I called late, so I made my parents worry.

words.example: 선배가 바빠서 제가 대신 손님을 만났어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My senior coworker was busy, so I met the client for him.
Thanks to my friend, I didn't get lost.

words.meaning: Don't mention it. (polite reply to thanks)
words.exampleMeaning: A: Thank you so much. B: Don't mention it.

words.meaning: to politely say no to an offer
words.exampleMeaning: She gave me a gift, but at first I politely said no.

dialogue.korean: 지은 씨, 잠깐 괜찮아요? 지난주 일 때문에 꼭 인사하고 싶었어요.
dialogue.meaning: Jieun, do you have a minute? I really wanted to thank you for last week.
Sure, go ahead. How are you feeling?

dialogue.korean: 이제 다 나았어요. 걱정 끼쳐서 미안해요. 그런데 제 보고서를 지은 씨가 대신 끝낸 줄은 정말 몰랐어요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm fully better now. Sorry I worried you. But I really didn't know you had finished my report for me.

dialogue.korean: 팀장님한테 들었어요. 주말에도 회사에 나온 줄은 몰랐어요. 지은 씨 덕분에 큰 문제 없이 넘어갔어요. 고생 많았어요.
dialogue.meaning: I heard from the team leader. I didn't know you even came in on the weekend. Thanks to you, it all went through without a big problem. You worked really hard.

dialogue.korean: 별말씀을요. 민준 씨도 제가 이사할 때 도와줬잖아요.
dialogue.meaning: Don't mention it. You helped me when I moved too, remember?

dialogue.korean: 그래도 이번에는 신세를 너무 많이 졌어요. 이 은혜는 꼭 갚을게요. 오늘 저녁은 제가 살게요.
dialogue.meaning: Still, I owe you a lot this time. I'll definitely pay you back. Dinner tonight is on me.

dialogue.korean: 하하, 이렇게까지 고마워할 줄은 몰랐네요. 그럼 사양하지 않을게요.
dialogue.meaning: Haha, I didn't expect you to be this grateful. Then I won't say no.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the past form (-(으)ㄴ 줄) of 기다리다: 선배가 비 오는 날 밖에서 한 시간이나 ____ 줄 몰랐어요.
Fill in the blank with 오다 in the honorific form + -(으)ㄹ 줄 (something you did not expect): 바쁘신데 병원까지 ____ 줄 몰랐어요. 정말 감사합니다.
Choose the right reply for B (별말씀을요 / 걱정 끼쳐서 미안해요): A: 제 발표 자료까지 챙겨 줘서 정말 고마워요. B: ____.
Read the dialogue again. Write True or False: ① 지은 씨는 주말에도 회사에 나왔다. ② 민준 씨는 지은 씨가 보고서를 끝낸 것을 미리 알고 있었다. ③ 지은 씨는 민준 씨가 사는 저녁을 사양했다.
Write two sentences in Korean to a friend who worked your shift while you were sick. Use 덕분에 and -(으)ㄴ 줄 몰랐어.
answers: ① True ② False ③ False
Sample answer: 네가 내 대신 일한 줄 몰랐어. 네 덕분에 푹 쉴 수 있었어.
